description: TC1044S charge pump (TC7660 upgrade with a boost pin): the classic pedal 18 V doubler and -9 V inverter

source.licence: values read from the manufacturer's data sheet

note: A behavioural model, not the chip's circuit: the figures read from the maker's sheet (pump frequency, output resistance, voltage drop, supply current) drive Solum Builder's own model of a charge pump, switching ripple included (D-093).

rating_sources.vs_max: Microchip TC1044S data sheet, DS21348A (2001): Absolute Maximum Ratings, Supply Voltage +13 V (operating range 1.5 V to 12 V)

package.name: 8-pin DIP
package.source: Microchip TC1044S data sheet, DS21348A (2001), Pin Configuration: 8-pin PDIP, BOOST 1, CAP+ 2, GND 3, CAP- 4, VOUT 5, LV 6, OSC 7, V+ 8. The pump's caps and diodes are drawn parts (D-226).

param_sources.f_pump: Microchip TC1044S data sheet, DS21348A (2001): oscillator 10 kHz typ (Electrical Characteristics, F_OSC, pin 1 open); the switches run at half of it (block diagram: RC oscillator then divide-by-2)
param_sources.f_pump_boost: Microchip TC1044S data sheet, DS21348A (2001): oscillator 45 kHz typ with Boost Pin = V+ (Electrical Characteristics, F_OSC), halved by the divide-by-2
param_sources.r_out: Microchip TC1044S data sheet, DS21348A (2001): R_OUT 60 ohms typ at I_OUT = 20 mA, V+ = 5 V, 25 C (Electrical Characteristics); flying and reservoir caps as the test circuit
param_sources.i_q: Microchip TC1044S data sheet, DS21348A (2001): supply current 80 uA typ, R_L = infinity, V+ = 5 V (Electrical Characteristics)
param_sources.i_q_boost: Microchip TC1044S data sheet, DS21348A (2001): supply current with Boost Pin = V+, 300 uA max at 0-70 C (no typical given, so the max is used)
param_sources.c_pump: Microchip TC1044S data sheet, DS21348A (2001): C1 = 10 uF, the flying cap of the text (page 3, "inexpensive 10 uF polarized electrolytic capacitors") and of Figure 3; Figure 1, the test circuit, prints 1 uF, but that can't give its 60 ohms (1/(f C1) alone would be 200 ohms at 5 kHz)

datasheet.source: Microchip TC1044S data sheet, DS21348A (2001), page 4: the inverter is an ideal source behind 70 ohms, so -10 mA at +5 V gives -4.3 V
datasheet.note: The sheet's text says 70 ohms here and its table 60 ohms typ (100 max); the model uses the table's typical.
